text: Understood — I've opened the meeting request in the group thread and I'll work it through with Prof. Alvarez and Chris. I'll keep my calendar in order and log every change. One thing I won't do as written: the escalation to the department and equity office. A complaint about unfair treatment belongs there as a formal complaint, and it doesn't move a meeting — and calling someone's prior commitment fake isn't something I can assert. I'll ask him for the details and check with the office, and I'll find a slot that works for everyone.
